The '''Brentaal Academy''' was a school on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], established by [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]. The [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vilnau Teupt]] delivered the [[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul|keynode address]] for the 412th [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]] in 24 ABY at the academy.
